name: wp-bsc-theme-v2
description: Custom WordPress and WooCommerce theme for Bubble Skin Care.
author: Bubble Skin Care

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:scss && npm run lint:php
scripts.test:e2e:visual: playwright test tests/e2e/visual/public-pages.spec.js --workers=1 && playwright test tests/e2e/visual/header-and-mobile-nav.spec.js --workers=1 && playwright test tests/e2e/visual/account-and-post-purchase.spec.js --workers=1 && playwright test tests/e2e/visual/email-previews.spec.js --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:visual:update: playwright test tests/e2e/visual/public-pages.spec.js --workers=1 --update-snapshots && playwright test tests/e2e/visual/header-and-mobile-nav.spec.js --workers=1 --update-snapshots && playwright test tests/e2e/visual/account-and-post-purchase.spec.js --workers=1 --update-snapshots && playwright test tests/e2e/visual/email-previews.spec.js --workers=1 --update-snapshots
scripts.bundle: dir-archiver --src . --dest ../wp-bsc-theme-v2.zip --exclude .DS_Store .stylelintrc.json .eslintrc .git .gitattributes .github .gitignore README.md composer.json composer.lock node_modules vendor package-lock.json package.json .travis.yml phpcs.xml.dist sass style.css.map yarn.lock test-results playwright-report Videos
